title: Planning a road trip
instructions: Jake ve Mia araba yolculuğu planlıyor. Uzun bir diyalog; rota, kalış yerleri ve görev dağılımını takip et.

script.speaker: jake
script.text: So, for our road trip, shall we drive along the coast or through the mountains?

script.speaker: mia
script.text: The coast. I want to stop at some beaches.

script.speaker: jake
script.text: OK. The whole trip is about eight hundred kilometres. We can do it in four days.

script.speaker: mia
script.text: Four days is good. Where shall we stay?

script.speaker: jake
script.text: Hotels are expensive in summer. What about camping?

script.speaker: mia
script.text: I don't like camping. What about small guest houses? They're cheaper than hotels.

script.speaker: jake
script.text: Good idea. Who's going to drive?

script.speaker: mia
script.text: Both of us. You drive in the mornings, and I'll drive in the afternoons.

script.speaker: jake
script.text: Deal. And I'll make a playlist for the car.

script.speaker: mia
script.text: Great. I'll book the guest houses tonight.

script.speaker: jake
script.text: Should we take your car or mine?

script.speaker: mia
script.text: Yours. Mine is too small for all our bags.

questions.feedback: Mia plajlarda durmak istediği için sahil yolunu seçiyorlar.
questions.evidence: The coast. I want to stop at some beaches.

questions.prompt: Where are they going to stay?
questions.feedback: Mia kamp sevmiyor; küçük pansiyonlarda kalacaklar.
Jake sabahları, Mia öğleden sonraları sürecek.
questions.evidence: and I'll drive in the afternoons.

questions.feedback: Mia'nın arabası çantalar için küçük; Jake'in arabasını alacaklar.
questions.evidence: Yours. Mine is too small for all our bags.
